stories.title: Microbiota-based cholesterol metabolism intervention investigated for colorectal cancer
stories.takeaway: A Nature Metabolism study examines microbiota-mediated changes in intratumoral cholesterol metabolism as a colorectal cancer treatment strategy.
stories.what_happened: Wu and colleagues report a microbiota-based approach to modifying cholesterol metabolism in colorectal tumors.
stories.why_it_matters: Links microbial activity to tumor metabolism and therapeutic design in intestinal cancer.
stories.caveat: Mechanistic and therapeutic generalizability, clinical efficacy and safety require independent validation.

stories.title: Randomized exercise trial measures gut microbiota changes in prediabetes
stories.takeaway: A 64-person randomized trial found higher gut microbial alpha-diversity after 12 weeks of HIIT than moderate continuous exercise.
stories.what_happened: Participants completed three supervised exercise sessions weekly for 12 weeks; investigators measured cardiometabolic outcomes and 16S rRNA microbiota profiles.
stories.why_it_matters: Demonstrates how a controlled lifestyle intervention can be paired with microbial ecology measurements in human participants.
stories.caveat: Microbiota was exploratory; 16S composition does not establish microbial mechanism, and the trial was small and short.

stories.title: Engineered 3D cardiac tissues reviewed as functional biosensing platforms
stories.takeaway: A new engineering review integrates microfabrication, bioelectronics and tissue maturation for cardiac disease modeling and drug testing.
stories.what_happened: The review compares engineered cardiac tissue architectures and mechanical/electrical readouts within a micro- and nanoengineering framework.
stories.why_it_matters: Offers transferable principles for evaluating physiological fidelity and functional readouts in organ-on-chip and new approach methods.
stories.caveat: A synthesis of diverse model systems, not evidence that any single platform predicts patient outcomes.

stories.title: Image-based single-cell transcriptomics maps plasma cell clonality in situ
stories.takeaway: A Nature Methods study presents spatially resolved assessment of plasma cell clonality using image-based single-cell transcriptomics.
stories.what_happened: Yang and colleagues combine imaging-based transcriptomic measurements with methods for profiling plasma-cell clonal identities in intact tissue.
stories.why_it_matters: Extends the toolkit for relating immune-cell identity and clonal organization to tissue context.
stories.caveat: Performance and biological interpretation depend on assay sensitivity, sampling and tissue-specific validation.

stories.title: 3D matrix mechanics and small molecules jointly shape cardiac reprogramming
stories.takeaway: A new 3D study examines how extracellular-matrix biophysical cues interact with small molecules during fibroblast-to-cardiomyocyte reprogramming.
stories.what_happened: McCoy and colleagues evaluated combinations of matrix properties and chemical factors in three-dimensional cardiac reprogramming models.
stories.why_it_matters: Highlights why mechanical microenvironments and biochemical cues should be evaluated together in engineered tissue systems.
stories.caveat: Cell reprogramming outcomes in 3D experimental models do not establish mature tissue integration or clinical regeneration.
